scope.description: Existing-record enrichment leads for published ONE9 and CAE records, resolved through official portfolio, company-issued news, ecosystem-program, Source Book, newsletter-discovery, government-overlap, and independent-publication lanes.

source.title: ONE9 national security investment platform and portfolio
source.locator: Investment Portfolio and Capability Labs sections
source.summary: ONE9's official site identifies its current security and defence investment portfolio and describes Capability Labs as a bridge between end-users, startups, technology validation, and venture investment.

leads.evidenceLocator: ONE9 official portfolio and Capability Labs pages plus Invest Ottawa's official September 2025 partnership release
followUpQuestions: Should every official portfolio company remain visible as a relationship, including the disclosed Tomahawk Robotics exit?
Should the Invest Ottawa relationship be retained as an ecosystem partnership rather than a program child?
reviewWarnings: Tomahawk Robotics is marked as an exit on ONE9's official portfolio and must remain explicitly labelled as a former portfolio company.
leads.refreshSummary: The current ONE9 record stores only one portfolio company. Official sources support six additional portfolio relationships, an Invest Ottawa and Area X.O partnership, and a fuller evidence-bounded summary of Capability Labs.
intendedChanges: Expand the profile portfolio summary from one to seven official portfolio names.
Add six missing portfolio or former-portfolio relationships.
Add the official Invest Ottawa and Area X.O defence-entrepreneur partnership.
Refine current activity to explain Capability Labs without implying procurement selection.

source.title: CAE and Leonardo expand collaboration on M-346 training
source.locator: Collaboration, technology-roadmap, LVC, LSI, Block 20, and AI-enabled training statements
source.summary: CAE and Leonardo announced an expanded M-346 Integrated Training System collaboration spanning advanced fighter training, Block 20, LVC and LSI environments, AI-enabled systems, and increasingly autonomous missions.

leads.evidenceLocator: CAE-issued July 22 announcement corroborated by independent aviation-industry reporting

aliases: CAE and Leonardo M-346 ITS collaboration

followUpQuestions: Should the Leonardo collaboration remain a current relationship and profile activity rather than a separate capability?
Should a later customer-specific award trigger a separate dated program update?
reviewWarnings: The agreement is a collaboration and technology roadmap, not a disclosed Canadian procurement award or customer-specific implementation.
leads.refreshSummary: CAE's current portfolio-level training coverage remains valid; the July 22 announcement adds a distinct Leonardo relationship and current M-346 LVC, LSI, Block 20, AI-enabled, and autonomous-mission training roadmap.
intendedChanges: Add Leonardo as a current M-346 integrated-training collaboration relationship.
Update current activity with the July 2026 training-roadmap scope and a clear no-award evidence boundary.
